job.job_description:
Position: Generative AI / Python / Agentic AI Developer
Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Noida , Hyderabad , Bangalore & Pune
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI & Agentic AI Developer with strong expertise in Python, LLMs, AI Agents, and modern AI frameworks. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI solutions leveraging Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and cloud technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks.
Build and optimize AI agents, multi-agent systems, and autonomous workflows.
Develop scalable backend services using Python.
Implement RAG pipelines using vector databases and embedding models.
Integrate Large Language Models (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.) into enterprise applications.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and monitor AI models for accuracy and performance.
Develop APIs and microservices for AI-enabled solutions.
Collaborate with business and engineering teams to identify AI automation opportunities.
Ensure AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Python
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering
Knowledge of Agentic AI / AI Agents
Hands-on with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks
Experience with RAG Architecture
Vector Databases: Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus
REST API development using FastAPI or Flask
Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Preferred Skills

Azure OpenAI / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI
Docker & Kubernetes
Knowledge Graphs
NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning
MLOps and AI model deployment

Keywords

Python, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM, GPT, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, RAG, Vector Database, Prompt Engineering, FastAPI, Flask, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Machine Learning, NLP, MLOps, Cloud AI.
